value.answer: Tomorrow in Toronto looks warm, about 25°C with a mix of sun and cloud. Environment Canada has a 40% chance of showers and a risk of thunderstorms late in the afternoon, and it'll feel like 32 with the humidity. It's windy from the southwest, gusting to 40 km/h. Tuesday night drops to 15°C, still with a chance of showers and storms in the evening. Some other forecasts have the showers earlier in the day, so the timing is a bit mixed.
